ja: 私はこれを運べる。
alternatives: I can move this.
I'm able to carry this.
point: can carry で持って運べると伝える。

ja: 3月からずっとこれ狙ってたんだ。
en: I've been eyeing it since March.
alternatives: I've had my eye on it since March.
I've been after it since March.
point: eye は「狙う」。since と現在完了進行形で「3月からずっと」

ja: 彼女はこの靴は長持ちすると言った。
en: She said these shoes would wear well.
alternatives: She said these shoes would last.
She said these shoes would hold up.
point: wear well は使い続けても傷みにくいこと。

ja: このシャツは安いよ。
alternatives: This shirt is inexpensive.
This shirt is a bargain.
point: 「安い」は cheap。this は近くの物

ja: ジャケットを返品したよ。
alternatives: I took the jacket back.
I brought the jacket back.
point: 返品する＝ return / take back

ja: ネットで買うのが好きだ。
alternatives: I like shopping online.
I enjoy buying stuff online.
point: like の後ろは -ing で「〜するのが好き」

ja: ズボンの丈を詰めてもらった。
en: I had my pants taken up.
alternatives: I got my pants shortened.
I had my pants shortened.
point: してもらうは have + 物 + 過去分詞

ja: 彼らの売り物が本物だとは思えない。
en: I doubt what they're selling is the real McCoy.
alternatives: I doubt their goods are genuine.
I don't think they're selling the genuine article.
point: the real McCoy は偽物でない本物のこと。

ja: いいのは、返品が簡単なことだ。
en: What's great is that returns are easy.
alternatives: The best part is that returns are easy.
The nice thing is that returns are easy.
point: What's great is that 節 で名詞節を作る

ja: もう一つ見せて。
alternatives: Let me see another.
Please show another one.
point: another one で同じ種類の別の商品。

ja: もっと安いのはありますか？
en: Do you have a cheaper one?
alternatives: Do you have anything cheaper?
Is there a cheaper one?
point: 「もっと安いの」は a cheaper one

ja: 私は現金で払うよ。
alternatives: I'll pay in cash.
I'll use cash to pay.
point: pay cash は現金で支払う。

ja: 試したほうがいいよ。
alternatives: You should give it a try.
You should try it out.
I'd try it.
point: 「〜したほうがいい」は should + 動詞の原形

ja: 私は靴を探してるの。
alternatives: I'm shopping for shoes.
I'm looking for some shoes.
point: 「探している」は be looking for

ja: もうあの店では二度と買わない。
en: Never again will I shop there.
alternatives: I'll never buy from that store again.
I will never shop at that store again.
point: Never again の後ろは will I の倒置

ja: 紙袋はレジ袋より丈夫です。
en: Paper bags are stronger than plastic.
alternatives: Paper bags are sturdier than plastic.
Paper bags are tougher than plastic ones.
point: 一般論は無冠詞の複数形で言う

ja: 散財してなきゃ、貯金があるのに。
en: If I hadn't splurged, I'd have savings.
alternatives: If I hadn't overspent, I'd have savings now.
If I hadn't splurged, I'd have money saved now.
point: 過去の原因と今の結果は if had + would 原形

ja: 青いほうを買っておけばよかった。
en: I wish I'd bought the blue one.
alternatives: If only I'd bought the blue one.
I should have bought the blue one.
point: 過去の後悔は wish + 過去完了

ja: もう荷物を受け取ったよ。
alternatives: I've already gotten the package.
I've already got the package.
point: 「もう〜した」は have + 過去分詞 + already

ja: レシートを残せばよかった。
en: I should have kept the receipt.
alternatives: I should've held on to the receipt.
I wish I'd kept the receipt.
point: 後悔は should have + 過去分詞

ja: 君は何色を選んだ？
alternatives: What color did you pick?
Which color was your choice?
point: which color で選んだ色を尋ねる。

ja: 私は代金を払ってる。
alternatives: I'm making a payment.
I'm paying for this.
point: am paying で今支払い中だと伝える。

ja: いつ再入荷するか分かりますか？
en: Do you know when it'll restock?
alternatives: Could you tell me when it restocks?
Do you know when they'll restock?
point: 間接疑問は when の後が平叙文の語順

ja: レシート、取っといて。
alternatives: Hold on to the receipt.
Save the receipt.
point: 「取っておく」は keep。命令文は動詞から始める

ja: もっと安ければ、買うのに。
en: If it were cheaper, I'd buy it.
alternatives: If it were any cheaper, I'd buy it.
Were it cheaper, I'd buy it.
point: 現在の仮定は if + 過去形、would + 原形

ja: この店は近い。
alternatives: This shop is close.
This store's near here.
point: nearby は近くにある。

ja: お得な話はもう消えていた。
alternatives: The deal had already vanished.
The offer had already disappeared.
point: evaporate は比喩的に消えてなくなること。

ja: 値引きなら私たちは奮発する。
alternatives: We'll treat ourselves if it's discounted.
If it's marked down, we'll splurge.
point: splurge はぜいたくにお金を使う。

ja: これ、試してもいい？
alternatives: May I try this?
Can I try this out?
point: 「〜していい？」は Can I + 動詞

ja: 決め手は、レビューの評価だった。
en: It was the reviews that sealed it.
alternatives: What sealed the deal was the reviews.
It was the reviews that clinched it.
point: It was ～ that で決め手を強調。seal the deal は決着させる

ja: セールで靴を買ったよ。
alternatives: I got some shoes on sale.
I picked up shoes on sale.
point: 「セールで」は on sale

ja: これの黒って、ありますでしょうか？
en: I was wondering if this comes in black.
alternatives: Would you happen to have this in black?
Do you by any chance have this in black?
point: I was wondering if で押しつけがましさを和らげる

ja: 私はこれを交換すべき？
alternatives: Should I swap this item?
Would exchanging this be better?
point: should I で交換する方がよいか相談する。

ja: 私にはこれはちょっと高すぎるかな。
en: This feels a shade too steep for me.
alternatives: This seems a little too expensive for me.
It's a touch too pricey for me.
point: a shade too steep はほんの少し高すぎるという言い方。

ja: この服は値下げされた。
alternatives: This piece was discounted.
This item's price was reduced.
point: was marked down はその服が値下げされたことを表す。

ja: 手数料を免除してもらえる？
alternatives: Could you drop the handling fees?
Could you remove the handling charges?
point: waive a fee は支払う義務を免除する。

ja: 知ってたら、買わなかったのに。
en: If I'd known, I'd have skipped it.
alternatives: If I'd known, I wouldn't have bought it.
Had I known, I wouldn't have bought it.
point: 過去の仮定は if + 過去完了、would have + 過去分詞

ja: Mはまだ残ってますか？
alternatives: Do you still have any mediums?
Is size M still available?
point: 「残っている」は there are ～ left

ja: これ、ずっと探してたんだ。
alternatives: I've been searching for this one.
I've been looking for this for ages.
point: 「ずっと〜してた」は have been ～ing

ja: セールを見に行ってきたよ。
en: I went to browse the sale.
alternatives: I went to check out the sale.
I went to look at the sale.
point: 目的の「〜しに」は to + 動詞

ja: 高くても、その価値はある。
en: Although it's expensive, it's worth it.
alternatives: Even though it's pricey, it's worth it.
Even if it's pricey, it's worth it.
point: 譲歩は although / even though。but は不要

ja: 売り切れだと店員が言ってた。
en: The clerk said it was sold out.
alternatives: They said it was sold out.
The clerk told me it was sold out.
point: said の後は時制を一つ過去にずらす

ja: 彼女は在庫があるか見てくると言った。
en: She said she'd check if it's in stock.
alternatives: She said she'd see if it's in stock.
She told me she'd check whether it's in stock.
point: 節の中に節。if は「かどうか」で語順は平叙文

ja: 返品の期限はいつですか？
alternatives: What's the deadline for returns?
What's the return deadline?
point: 「いつ」は when、期限は deadline

ja: 私は君に選んでほしい。
alternatives: I'd like you to pick.
I want you to decide.
point: want + 人 + to で選択を頼む。

ja: これにするよ。
alternatives: I'll go with this one.
I'll get this one.
point: その場で決めたことは I'll。買うは take もよく使う

ja: サイズが見つからず、私は出た。
en: Unable to find my size, I left.
alternatives: Not finding my size, I left the store.
Since I couldn't find my size, I left.
point: 分詞構文は主語を省き、否定は Not / Unable to

ja: これ、返品したいんですが。
en: I'd like to send this back.
alternatives: I'd like to return this.
I'd like to take this back.
point: 返品は send back / take back の句動詞
